DescribeAdvices.description_en: Retrieves the latest inspection results for a user based on multiple dimensions and returns all results
DescribeAdvices.description_zh: 可根据多个维度获取用户最新的巡检结果，全量返回

DescribeAdvicesFlatPage.description_en: Retrieves the latest inspection results based on multiple dimensions and returns them in a paginated format with certain fields flattened
DescribeAdvicesFlatPage.description_zh: 可根据多个维度获取用户最新的巡检结果，分页返回（部分字段展平）

DescribeAdvicesPage.description_en: Retrieves the latest inspection results based on multiple dimensions and returns them in pages
DescribeAdvicesPage.description_zh: 可根据多个维度获取用户最新的巡检结果，分页返回

DescribeAdvisorChecks.description_en: Retrieves the inspection items currently available to the user
DescribeAdvisorChecks.description_zh: 获取用户当前可用的巡检项

DescribeAdvisorResources.description_en: Retrieves the inspection resources (the latest results are available only after resource information synchronization is triggered)
DescribeAdvisorResources.description_zh: 拉取巡检资源列表（需要在触发资源信息同步后才能获取最新结果）

DescribeCostCheckAdvices.description_en: Queries the details of cost optimization results
DescribeCostCheckAdvices.description_zh: 查询成本优化结果详情

DescribeCostCheckResults.description_en: Queries the aggregated cost optimization results overview for inspection items
DescribeCostCheckResults.description_zh: 查询巡检项聚合成本优化结果概览

GetHistoryAdvices.description_en: Queries historical inspection results with pagination. You can filter results by product, date, and severity level
GetHistoryAdvices.description_zh: 分页获取历史巡检结果，按产品、日期、严重级别查询

GetInspectProgress.description_en: Retrieves the execution progress of a task for a regular user or a single account in a resource directory
GetInspectProgress.description_zh: 获取任务执行进度(普通用户、RD单账号)

GetProductList.description_en: Retrieves the list of cloud services

GetTaskStatusById.description_en: Queries the execution status of a task by task ID
GetTaskStatusById.description_zh: 根据任务ID查询任务执行状态

RefreshAdvisorCheck.description_en: Refreshes diagnostic items, triggers resource metric synchronization for the inspection items, and re-runs the inspection. This API creates inspection tasks based on multiple dimensions (cloud product, cloud resource, and diagnostic item name). If all dimensions are left empty, inspection tasks are created for all diagnostic items across all resources under the user by default
RefreshAdvisorCheck.description_zh:
刷新诊断项，触发该巡检项的资源指标同步并重新巡检。
该API会按照输入的多个维度（云产品、云资源、诊断项名称）创建巡检任务，都为空则默认按照该用户下所有资源为所有诊断项创建巡检任务

RefreshAdvisorResource.description_en: Triggers a resource information synchronization task based on a specific product and resource ID, and returns the ID of the created task
RefreshAdvisorResource.description_zh: 根据具体的产品+资源ID，触发资源信息同步任务，返回创建的任务ID
